text:
The Juniper planning meetings (3–10 Nov) set configuration and ownership for 25 modules. Final values after corrections: upload batch_size 200, billing 750, ledger 450, quota 900, export 350, session 250, metrics queue_depth 270, media 490, alerts timeout_s 20, and checkout ttl_s 360.

Fixed requirements include feed retry_limit 9, sync retry_limit 8, pricing retry_limit 6, and gateway batch_size 450. Ownership is set for reports and profile (gamma), alerts (beta), and metrics (delta).

Separation rules: checkout and sync, export and feed, catalog and shipping, and billing and checkout must run on different workers. Shipping and upload must share one worker.

Banned dependency paths: search→feed, sync→media, session→ledger, and archive→ingest.

Rollout order: metrics before reports, feed before scheduler, and quota before session.

Open items: the security review and the budget review (next Thursday).
